query:
insert or ignore into SkippedTestRuns (
                agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            )
            with TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase (
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            ) as (
                select
                    test_collect_nr,
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    test_run_date
                from ResolvedTestCaseStates
                where agg_collect_nr = $1
                and state = $2
            ), IndirectSkippedTestRun (
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            ) as (
                select
                    d.collect_nr,
                    d.product_id,
                    d.test_run_name,
                    d.test_run_date
                from TestRunDescendants d, TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase s
                where d.collect_nr = s.test_collect_nr
                and d.product_id = s.product_id
                and d.descendant_test_run_name = s.test_run_name
                and d.descendant_test_run_date = s.test_run_date
            )
            select
                $1 as agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            from (
                select
                    test_collect_nr,
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    test_run_date
                from TestRunsWithSkippedTestCase

                union all

                select
                    test_collect_nr,
                    product_id,
                    test_run_name,
                    test_run_date
                from IndirectSkippedTestRun
            )

            except

            select
                agg_collect_nr,
                test_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                test_run_name,
                test_run_date
            from FailedTestRuns
            where agg_collect_nr = $1
